step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an end user requesting video content from an Operator portal, then requesting a DRM license from Irdeto Control hosted on AWS. The core AWS architecture consists of an EC2 cluster running Kubernetes pods (DRM adaptation modules, rules engine, and core functions) connected to two RDS databases: a primary control database storing stateful information/policies and a data warehouse database storing events/reporting data.

graph.name: Irdeto Multi-DRM Architecture on AWS
graph.notes: Multi-DRM solution using Kubernetes on EC2 and Amazon RDS for policy storage and analytics.
